title: Mascot hero
description: Friendly brand-mascot hero (16:9): a procedural fox waving on a pastel pedestal with a 3D speech bubble (text from scene.data), its head and eyes following the pointer; click or tap it and it jumps into a celebration with confetti and a new line, then settles back. Left half free for an HTML headline. Swap the style for an astronaut, robot, cat, bird, blob or ghost.
